convert_slow_tokenizer_to_fast: convert a Marian MT slow tokenizer to a fast tokenizer using MarianConverter
create_marian_converter: create a MarianConverter instance from a slow tokenizer with a specific sentencepiece index
build_vocab_from_proto: build a vocabulary list from protobuf sentencepiece pieces using the vocab method
save_fast_tokenizer: save a converted fast Marian tokenizer to a JSON file on disk
load_marian_tokenizer: load a Helsinki-NLP Marian MT slow tokenizer from a pretrained model using AutoTokenizer
